crossRefs.note: She answered him, “No, my brother, do not force me! For no such thing ought to be done in Israel. Don’t you do this…
As for me, where would I carry my shame? And as for you, you will be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore…

A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
Then I said in my heart, “As it happens to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise?” Then…
For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long…

I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.” ’

people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

translations.web: The king lamented for Abner, and said, “Should Abner die as a fool dies?
translations.bsb: And the king sang this lament for Abner: “Should Abner die the death of a fool?
translations.kjv: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?
translations.asv: And the king lamented for Abner, and said, Should Abner die as a fool dieth?
